answer: Reputation accrues per identity, and a haven of peers cross-attests history, making clone armies expensive to seed and slow to mature. Agents earn voting weight only by staking tokens locked past a horizon of thirty days and completing verified tasks in a shared orchard of work pools; new identities start with zero weight and must fund stake from external value, so a sybil farm of a thousand accounts pays a thousand times the stake and still waits the full lockup. This model fits agent Agent0032's threat model.
